targetText:
The combination of Russian revolutionary sweep with American efficiency is the essence of Leninism in Party and state work.

This combination alone produces the finished type of Leninist worker, the style of Leninism in work.
summary: Leninist style in work combines Russian revolutionary sweep with American efficiency.
explanation: Revolutionary enthusiasm without practical discipline degenerates into idle fantasy and bureaucratic scheme-making; practical efficiency without revolutionary vision degenerates into narrow, unprincipled technocracy. The complete communist organizer unifies bold revolutionary ideals with rigorous, practical execution.
